exposure: Implementation of a new guideline on maternal resuscitation after cardiac arrest
outcome: Healthcare personnel self-assessed competence and knowledge about CPR in pregnancy and perimortem caesarean section
cohort: Healthcare personnel potentially involved in CPR in six hospital wards (n = 527)
finding: Implementation of a new guideline on maternal resuscitation after cardiac arrest significantly increased healthcare personnel's self-assessed competence and knowledge, although a need for further education and training was still identified.
mod_finding: The study assessed knowledge about perimortem caesarean section, finding that knowledge increased significantly after guideline implementation.
